common_name: Slender Greenthread / Edwards Plateau Greenthread / Navajo Tea
look_here_first: Start with the sparse foliage and perennial habit. Slender greenthread is a slender perennial with relatively few stem leaves, lower leaves often divided into 3–5 narrow segments, upper leaves simpler and threadlike, and yellow-rayed heads on long peduncles.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — University of Texas Plant Resources Center Travis County specimen index documents Thelesperma simplicifolium. Williamson — University of Texas Williamson County flora documents the species. Burnet — herbarium specimen record documents a collection west of Spicewood in Burnet County.

taxonomy_notes.source_note: ITIS treats Thelesperma simplicifolium as accepted.

best_field_traits: lower leaves often divided into 3–5 narrow segments
upper leaves simpler and narrow to linear
yellow ray florets around a yellow to brownish disk
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with T. filifolium, T. simplicifolium is perennial and typically much more sparsely leafy, with fewer and less repeatedly divided stem leaves. T. filifolium is usually an annual with more consistently dissected threadlike foliage.
